recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future Pharmacy decision reopens MedicationRequest v2 mapping for prescription validity.
issue_request: FHIR-7816 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the 2015 May DSTU QA process. It asked to remove the HL7 v2 mapping for MedicationPrescription.dispense/validityPeriod because RXD-3/RXD-19 do not express the prescription validity window.
initial_application: SVN-migrated commit 651364cb098a623c36afc1d6b9d56578507d897c removed `v2 Mapping = RXD-3-Date/Time Dispensed ? / RXD-19-Substance Expiration Date` from MedicationOrder.dispenseRequest.validityPeriod as part of tracker #7816 and related medication mapping cleanup.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps medicationrequest=MedicationRequest active and records that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest. Current MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.validityPeriod has Script 10.6 and RIM mappings only, and current source search found no RXD-19/Substance Expiration Date v2 mapping on that element. Community searches found no Zulip or Confluence evidence contradicting the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active current source already preserves the requested v2 mapping removal.
